[ASSISTANT_SAID] Notable artists and workshops that specialized in creating illuminated manuscripts include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. The Limbourg Brothers - a workshop of three Dutch brothers who created the famous Très Riches Heures du Duc de Berry manuscript.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. The Book of Kells - a manuscript created by Irish monks in the 9th century.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. The Tresor de Montsegur - a collection of manuscripts created by a group of Cathars in the 14th century.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. The Winchester Bible - a manuscript illuminated by a team of artists in England in the 12th century.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. The Hours of Catherine of Cleves - a manuscript created in the Netherlands in the 15th century.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Tres Riches Heures du Duc de Berry is also considered to be a masterpiece of the genre due to its stunning depictions of the four seasons and richly detailed scenes of courtly life.
